title: Clear PvP Pack
description: A pvp pack that applies many details such as blocks and items to help in your many pvp needs. Just a warning this is still in beta stages and i will release new better versions soon.
body:
# Clear PvP Pack

A clean and optimized Minecraft texture pack designed for PvP and everyday gameplay.

## Features

✨ Clear GUI for a cleaner and less cluttered experience

⚔️ Custom Swords & Axes with a sleek PvP-focused design

📦 Small Items to improve visibility during combat

🛡️ Custom Armor Textures for a unique look while maintaining Minecraft's style

🌊 Clear Water for better underwater visibility

🔥 Small Fire to help you see opponents more easily during battles

## Perfect For

* PvP
* Bedwars
* SkyWars
* Survival
* Crystal PvP
* General gameplay

This pack keeps Minecraft's original feel while providing cleaner visuals and competitive advantages where it matters most.

Compatible with the latest Minecraft versions.

## Compatibility

This texture pack is fully designed for multiple Minecraft versions, but has been tested primarily on 1.21 releases.

The pack may also work on some older Minecraft versions, though full compatibility has not been thoroughly tested. Certain textures or features may appear differently depending on the version being used.

## Usage & Permissions

You are free to use, modify, remix, and include any files from this texture pack in your own projects, texture packs, or resource packs.

**The only requirement is that proper credit is given to the original creator.**

By using assets from this pack, you agree to provide visible attribution wherever the modified or redistributed content is shared.
